# Motif

> CLI and Node SDK for image and video work on fal.ai, organised by Task. The caller names the job (erase, upscale, relight) and a Tier (fast, balanced, quality); Motif chooses the Model and can price every call with a dry run before it spends anything.

## Start here

- [README](./README.md) - install, the task table, Tiers, overriding the Model, looks and moods, series, the SDK and config.
- [Agent instructions](./AGENTS.md) - repo commands, package map, architecture rules and permission boundaries.
- [CLI agent guide](./apps/cli/AGENTS.md) - driving the `motif` command from an agent.
- [Domain language](./CONTEXT.md) - Task, Model, Tier, Source, Reference, Series, Look, Mood.
- [Security notes](./docs/security.md) - key handling, local history exposure and ephemeral runs.

## What do you want to do?

One verb per Task. `motif --describe tasks --format json` maps task words to verbs and says what to use instead; `motif --describe <verb> --format json` is one Task's schema.

- `motif "prompt"` - make an image, or change one passed with `-e`. Add `--look <id>` and `--mood <id>` for a house style and light.
- `motif vary [image]` - variations of an image.
- `motif erase "what" [image]` - remove something and fill the gap (`--text`, `--boxes`, `--mask`, `--with`).
- `motif cutout [image-or-video]` - remove the background.
- `motif reframe [image] --og` - extend to a new ratio (`--margin`, `--sizes`).
- `motif upscale [image-or-video]` - make it larger (`--scale`, `--transparent`, `--generative`, `--creative`).
- `motif restore [image]` - fix noise, softness, damage, tone or colour.
- `motif relight [image] "light"` - relight to a described light or `--mood` (`--even`, `--flat`).
- `motif restyle [image] --like <image>` - redraw in a reference's style.
- `motif segment "what" [image-or-video]` - mask or cut out a named thing (`--auto`, `--rle`).
- `motif ask "question" [image]` - caption, count, find or read (`--caption`, `--detect`, `--point`, `--read`, `--safe`).
- `motif layers [image]` - split into transparent layers (`--text`).
- `motif vectorize [image]` - trace to a clean SVG.
- `motif map [image]` - depth, edge, line, normal or pose map.
- `motif material [image]` - PBR maps from a surface photo (`--extract`).
- `motif tile "prompt" [image]` - a seamlessly tiling texture (`--upscale`).
- `motif mesh [image]` - a textured 3D mesh (`--rig`, `--objects`, `--body`).
- `motif try-on [image] --garment <image>` - dress a person in a garment.
- `motif animate "prompt" [image]` - turn an image into a video.
- `motif sheet <images...>`, `motif series run "theme"`, `motif series <subcommand>`, `motif studio` - contact sheets, themed sets, reusable styles, the terminal app. These choose no Model.

Rules for agents: `--dry-run` first, `--no-open` and `--fields` in a pipeline, parse JSON not human output. Let Motif choose the Model; `--tier` trades cost for quality and `-m <model>` overrides the choice, with `--param key=value` for Model-only fields. `cost: null` means unknown until the call returns, not free. `--rmbg`, `--up`, `--vary`, `--video`, `enhance` and `tool` exit `2` with `REMOVED_COMMAND` naming the verb.

- [Tasks](./apps/cli/docs/verbs.md) - every verb: usage, modes, flags, examples, what to use instead.
- [Generate and vary](./apps/cli/docs/generate.md) - Tiers, override Models, looks and moods, stdin JSON, transparency, prompt warnings.
- [Costs](./apps/cli/docs/costs.md) - per-Model prices by Task, for overrides.
- [Output](./apps/cli/docs/output.md) - where each command puts its path, field masks, chaining, pagination.
- [Errors](./apps/cli/docs/errors.md) - the catalogue, including `NO_MODEL_AVAILABLE`, `TASK_FAILED` and `REMOVED_COMMAND`.
- [Series](./apps/cli/docs/series.md) - themed runs, references, pinned looks and moods.

## SDK

- [SDK package](./packages/motif-sdk) - `@howells/motif-sdk`. `createMotif()` returns one function per Task plus `plan(task, input)` (resolve, build and price with no I/O) and `run(task, input)`, each returning a `Result`. `TASKS` holds the rankings; `resolveTask` chooses the Model. `@howells/motif-sdk/image` is the provider-agnostic image layer.
- [Task rankings](./packages/motif-sdk/src/tasks.ts) - every Task's summary, modes and ranked Models with Tiers.
- [Task client](./packages/motif-sdk/src/task-client.ts) - `createMotif`, `plan`, `run` and the input and output types.

## Packages and tests

- [CLI package](./apps/cli) - `@howells/motif-cli`, the `motif` binary and terminal Studio.
- Checks run locally, not in CI: `pnpm check` builds, typechecks, lints and runs the tests.
